The '''Sith Wars''' of the 3600s BBY<ref name="TEGTW" /> were a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide struggle between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], which had vowed revenge against the Republic after the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith]] defeat in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] of [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="TORE" /> [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] resurgence in earlier [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] resulted in the [[Old Sith Wars]], which likewise ended in a Republic victory in [[3950 BBY]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II||Old Sith Wars}}</ref> Under [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], the Empire [[Battle of Korriban|launched]] the [[Great Galactic War]] on the Republic in [[3681 BBY]], and while the two factions negotiated a ceasefire with the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]], a [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] persisted until around [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="TORE" />

The Republic and the Empire returned to battle with the outbreak of the [[Galactic War]],<ref name="TORE" /> and while Vitiate abandoned his empire to oversee the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]],<ref name="Chapter1">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=1}}</ref> the [[Eternal Alliance]] defeated the [[Eternal Empire]],<ref name="Chapter9">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=9}}</ref> allowing the Republic and the Empire to continue their struggle with a [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Meridian" /> In that war, [[Darth Malgus]] came into conflict with Emperor [[Darth Vowrawn]] and the [[Dark Council]], as well as the [[Alliance Commander]], who had sided with the Republic.<ref name="Secrets">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref>

After the Sith Wars of the 3600s, continuing militarism in the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Axis]] reinvigorated old tensions in the region, instigating the [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Wars were first mentioned, albeit indirectly, in the [[2004]] [[Obsidian Entertainment]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''.<ref name="TSL" /> The struggle first appeared in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] ''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]'',<ref name="Threat1">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''</ref> and was first identified in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

As opposed to the wars between the Jedi and the Sith depicted in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] media, ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] stated that there has never been a war between the two groups.<ref name="Archives">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref>
